input.evidence: Close-up crops show the boxed cow (the all-black one behind the white-faced cow) standing at the yellow waterer the whole time. At -15 s and 0 s her head is down inside the waterer, behind the rail. At +5 s and +15 s her head is raised to rail height, still right over the waterer, which looks like a pause between swallows. She stays in the same spot across the frames, so she is not walking. Her ears and head carriage look normal, and I saw no discharge, but the resolution is limited.
input.self_check: I checked four time offsets (-15, 0, +5 and +15 s) and the whole-camera frames at -20 and 0 s; the +20 s frame was not available. Her muzzle was clearly in the waterer at 2 of the 4 offsets, and her head stayed raised over it at the other two. If those raised-head periods take up most of the minute, the better label would be standing at the waterer. I may also have the wrong cow: the white-faced cow next to her overlaps the box, but her head is away from the waterer.
